query.sql: select count(*) as Found from spriden where spriden_id= :studentId and spriden_change_ind is null
query.name: Found

query.sql: select a.spraddr_street_line1 line1,a.spraddr_street_line2 line2,a.spraddr_street_line3 line3, a.spraddr_city city, a.spraddr_stat_code province, a.spraddr_zip postal, a.spraddr_natn_code country from spraddr a inner join spriden i on a.spraddr_pidm=i.spriden_pidm where i.spriden_id = :studentId and i.spriden_Change_ind is null and a.spraddr_status_ind is null and spraddr_atyp_code='MA' and (spraddr_to_date is null or spraddr_to_date < sysdate)
query.name: Addresses

query.sql: select a.sprtele_phone_area||a.sprtele_phone_number as phone from sprtele a inner join spriden i on a.sprtele_pidm=i.spriden_pidm where i.spriden_id = :studentId and i.spriden_Change_ind is null and a.sprtele_status_ind is null and sprtele_tele_code='MA' order by a.sprtele_primary_ind desc
query.name: Phones

query.sql:
SELECT sum(nvl(tbraccd_balance, 0)) as Balance
      FROM tbraccd t
      inner join spriden s on s.spriden_pidm=tbraccd_pidm
      where
      s.spriden_id=:studentId
      and s.spriden_change_ind is null
query.name: Balance
